scope: Composer origin and native model-search keyboard ownership review; syntax validation only.
source_review: ChatViewBottom and HanlinMorphComposer use only host-local available size and a single layout result for editor, controls and glass. Removed global UIScreen keyboard subtraction and asynchronous enclosing input/editor frame feedback.
The model toolbar custom view is constrained to 44pt height and the source controller's local width; UIKit sourceItem anchors its popover. Popup content applies only container safe area.
The compact keyboard probe converts the typed keyboard screen frame through its actual UIWindow into local bounds. Its .global reads are DEBUG/HANLIN_TESTING diagnostics only.

Native model presentation supplies an owner token before presentation; its registered composer keeps keyboard avoidance when focus enters model search. Dismissal and dismantle remove that token. Old tokens cannot clear newer owners.
Original 52pt plus, bottom alignment, 10pt input/plus gap, 13pt panel/input gap and 32pt shared glass merge distance remain unchanged.
native_validation: Not run. Physical iPad tests must exercise narrow/wide transitions, Stage Manager/global-origin changes, keyboard show/hide, expand/collapse, model-search focus and native popover dismissal.
